title: Moment of Inertia of Discrete Point Masses

variables.I: Moment of inertia about the specified axis
variables.r_i: Perpendicular distance of the i-th particle from the axis

assumptions: Point mass particles with negligible individual extents
Strictly perpendicular radial distances measured from the rotation axis
Rigid spatial configuration among all particles
validity_conditions: Universal definition for any finite system of discrete particles in classical mechanics
common_misuse: Using direct vector distance from an origin instead of perpendicular distance from the axis
Assuming moment of inertia is an intrinsic scalar independent of axis location
